decision.observation: Dig tool is active: a shovel cursor sits over the sandstone just left of the platform, and a Tool Filter panel is open. Three duplicants remain idle. Warnings persist.
decision.hypothesis: Dragging the Dig tool across the reachable sandstone beside the platform will mark it for mining, producing raw mineral for a ladder.
decision.memory: Ladder needs 100 kg raw mineral or wood. Reachable sandstone borders the starting platform. Copper ore below is unreachable until a ladder exists. Oxygen Diffuser needs 200 kg metal ore. Outhouse also required.
